channel.title: Hacks on ZooBerry
channel.description: Recent content in Hacks on ZooBerry

item.title: Hacks
item.description: Make changes to gameplay, add new features, or fix bugs in Zoo Tycoon 1!

item.title: No Grass, Please! - Dinosaur Digs Overhaul Pack
item.description: “No Grass, Please!” is an ambitious attempt to rectify some of the mistakes made by Blue Fang and adapt Dinosaur Digs as much as possible to present-day science.

item.title: ZTCC Dinosaur Attractiveness Boost
item.description: Tired of your guests favoring the bog standard Moose over the research mandated Ankylosaurus? Tired of your guests being so disinterested in virtually all prehistoric animals compared to modern fauna? This is the mod for you.

item.title: Insectivore Anteater Hack
item.description: Tired of seeing your anteaters eating hay? Here’s a hack that fixes your anteater’s diet by replacing it with the insectivore chow (just like in real life)

item.title: Swimming Jaguar
item.description: A patch that allows jaguars to swim in water terrain and tanks.

item.title: DDvarPatch
item.description: Contains some edits to “classic” Dinosaur Digs files.

item.title: Quivaz Moving Hack
item.description: A handy hack that allows you to move certain buildings without needing to sell them, making zoo redesigns easier.

item.title: Invisible Fences Cheat Code
item.description: Use cheat codes to make fences invisible!
